limitations: Summary success is evidence verification, not completion of the source diagnostic or T01 acceptance.
physical_validity remains null: neither collider lists nor identity Teleport success prove general nonpenetration.
Overlap can include contact; source MeshCollider/disabled-collider coverage and penetration depth remain unknown.
Every non-bookkeeping metadata field is compared exactly; currentTime is preserved as a separate reported difference.
Euler metadata differences are reported without a new tolerance or a claim about quaternion/physical equivalence.
RGB comparisons concern returned saved event images, not inferred fresh-render counts.
Cases after the first stop and objects in a scene that did not settle were not measured; they are not negative collision results.
Matching scene and random seed do not establish identical initial poses or motion state across runs; no repeated-state or causal claim is inferred.
Portable evidence contains every file authenticated by each final worker index plus that index and its incremental log; Unity logs/caches are outside this archive scope.

source_config.name: t01_collision_pack_01_probe
limitations: Diagnostic observations only: no valid_physical or accepted-pair decision is produced, and no old result is promoted.
Old query returns collider names, not unique object IDs; names are never used as an ignore list.
The positions[] TeleportObject overload invokes firstColliderObjectCollidingWith with forceAction=False; source triggers are excluded there.
Both native paths use primitive Capsule/Box/Sphere overlaps; source MeshCollider coverage and collider.enabled state are not exposed by these observations.
Overlap can report touching support geometry; no penetration depth, contact manifold, or general mesh nonpenetration proof is available.
Identity teleport is an action with possible side effects, not a pure query. All non-bookkeeping metadata and exact float representations remain in comparisons.
currentTime is retained and compared. A clock-only difference does not claim exact full state or absence of side effects; it permits the next diagnostic object only.
CPU fixtures validate bookkeeping and failure preservation only; they cannot establish Unity API compatibility.
